title: Ordinary finite-coefficient Chern classes
statement:
Use [def-pur-conventions] at finite coefficients $A=A_{E,n}$ and ordinary cohomology $H^{2i}(T,A(i))$ of [def-pur-support-cohomology] with full support. Let $F$ be a locally free module of rank $r$ on a separated finite-type $k$-scheme $T$. For $r>0$ put $q:P=\mathbf P_T(F)\to T$ in the quotient convention [lem-pur-projective-bundle-tautological-geometry], and put $h=c_{1,A}(\mathcal O_P(1))$ [lem-pur-kummer-additivity]. Expand $h^r$ uniquely in the basis $1,h,\ldots,h^{r-1}$ using the inverse of the isomorphism [thm-pur-projective-bundle-formula] on ordinary cohomology. Define $c_i(F)\in H^{2i}(T,A(i))$ for $1\leq i\leq r$ by the signed coefficients in
$$h^r-q^*c_1(F)h^{r-1}+q^*c_2(F)h^{r-2}-\cdots+(-1)^rq^*c_r(F)=0.$$
Products are the full-support instance of [def-pur-supported-cup]. Set $c_0(F)=1$ and $c_i(F)=0$ for $i>r$; for $r=0$ these conventions define all the classes without forming $\mathbf P(0)$. These are ordinary Chern classes, defined without reference to a section, a supported Euler class, or a purity isomorphism.
